name: warden
description: Self-hosted licence manager on Cloudflare Workers: create licence keys, set their status, and give each one a check URL your sites can call.

scripts.typecheck: npm run cf-typegen && react-router typegen && tsc -b

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Username for the Warden dashboard. If your setup flow cannot set runtime variables, skip this and add it after deploying (Worker Settings > Variables and Secrets).

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the dashboard (12+ random characters, stored as an encrypted secret). Can also be added after deploying; the app shows setup instructions until it exists.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Optional. Random string (32+ chars, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`) used to sign login cookies. If left empty a key is derived from the admin password.
